content.short: Blockchain At UCSB is a student-run organization that promotes blockchain awareness and education at UCSB.
content.description: Blockchain At UCSB is a student-led organization focused on increasing blockchain awareness and understanding across the UCSB campus by organizing events, workshops, and talks. The group provides a platform for students to learn, discuss, and collaborate on blockchain projects and ideas. It partners with campus clubs and organizations such as CodersSB, Data Science SB, and SBhacks to broaden its reach within the university community. It also offers free and discounted tickets to conferences like Crypto Invest Summit, helping members engage with the wider blockchain ecosystem.
